title: Alcantara, Rivera advance in mixed doubles at Asian Games
summary: The tandem of Niño Alcantara and Shaira Rivera moved past Iran's Meshkatolzahra Safi and Kasra Rahmani, 6-4, 1-6 [10-8], to advance in tennis mixed doubles at the 20th Asian Games.
